statement.en: ESGE recommends the best practice technique described below for retrieval of polyp tissue after EMR.

text.en: Use of an endoscopic retrieval net is recommended when performing piecemeal polypectomy.
If performing en bloc resection, the snare can be used to retrieve the resected polyp tissue.

(If using a snare) care should be taken to ensure the snare does not cut through the lesion and that the scope is used to protect the specimen at retrieval through the anus by pulling the specimen up against the scope tip.
Suction of transected tissue through the endoscope channel for retrieval may interfere with histologic interpretation.
The retrieval device should be positioned at 6 o’clock (when using a colonoscope).
Pieces should be captured using a sequential place, close, compact, and open approach.
Pinning the polyp tissue to a corkboard after en bloc resection is useful, but this is not useful after piecemeal resection (apart from when a large piece suspicious for SMI is resected).
